summary.headline: Contents of Codex Vaticanus 208
summary.text: Catalog description of Codex Vaticanus 208, a fifteenth-century paper manuscript formerly Athous, with a sixteenth-century index and material by Isaac Argyrus, Theon of Alexandria, and Claudius Ptolemy. Listed contents include equinoctial and seasonal hours, synodic and full-moon tables, astronomical handy tables, Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, and the twelve places with their centers, succedents, and cadents.
